title: NANSEN entity method
description: A method that runs on entities of one type: where its code is in each language, and the JSON Schema of its options. The defaults in that schema are the default options, and the frontend renders option forms from it. A serial method is called once per entity as f(entity, options, context); a batch method once with all selected entities as f(entities, options, context). A method may return a struct/dict of column values, which a computed fragment writes to the table.

category.description: Menu group, e.g. 'Process' or 'Plot'. Slashes nest groups.

entityType.description: The entity type the method runs on, * for any, @project for a project tool: it runs once on the project, as function(project, options, context), or @file for a file method: it runs on one file from the file viewer (files.run), as function(file, options, context), file being {path, root} (dev's project filemethods).

python.description: 'module.path:function', imported from the declaring module's folder.

matlab.description: Function name, on the path while the declaring module is in use.

files.description: Of a file method (entityType @file): the files it is offered for, on the file viewer's menus, and runs on (files.run refuses others with unsupported-file); any file when absent. NANSEN dev showed its Download File for empty files only.

extensions.description: Files whose names end in one of these, in any case, such as .tif or .nii.gz

empty.description: true: empty files only (placeholders, as dev's Download File); false: files with something in them only

queueable.description: Whether the method may run in the background task queue.

options.description: A draft-07 JSON Schema for the options object (type object, with properties). Each property's default is its default value.

legacySessionMethod.description: The MATLAB implementation is a session method of NANSEN dev, imported unchanged (methods.importLegacy): a function varargout = name(sessionObject, varargin) whose attributes come from nansen.session.SessionMethod.setAttributes, or a subclass of nansen.session.SessionMethod. nansen.runMethod calls it with a nansen.legacy.SessionShim per entity (dev's session object) and dev's default options with the run's options over them.
